beats.headline: Given memories of a child that was never made
beats.text: Subject conducts the Mango Line. He was also issued with a set of memories containing a daughter, and the daughter was never made, and he has worked that out and cannot understand it. He is found on the ground with his head down and a puddle forming underneath him. The memories work. That is the part of the design I would draw attention to.

beats.headline: Rides the Nightmare down
beats.text: Subject Tizquick, conductor, helped drive the Nightmare to the trainyard and then stayed aboard. He and Fire Brandy discussed it and decided together. He knows how this works, he says, and promises to make her blow nice and big just before the bottom of the pit. Carl's reading is that he went because his daughter was a lie. Soon after, Bautista reports feeling the generator on his side explode.
